headline: Benny Gantz withdraws 8 days before the vote (Blue and White below threshold)
dek: Gantz withdrew Oct 19 after polls consistently showed Blue and White below the 3.25% threshold, to avoid wasting anti-Netanyahu votes; party stays on ballot unless all candidates withdraw. Polls signal a tight race with neither Netanyahu nor rival Gadi Eisenkot projected to reach 61 seats.
sources: Al Jazeera (newsbeep), Yedioth Ahronoth/Ynet (via Türkiye Today), Reuters (via ThePrint), AP (via TVB News)
fault_line: Does Trump's endorsement plus wartime posture lock Netanyahu back into power — or do war-weary voters punish the far-right coalition that failed on Oct 7?

sections.what_happened: Gantz withdrew Oct 19 after polls consistently showed Blue and White below the 3.25% threshold, to avoid wasting anti-Netanyahu votes; party stays on ballot unless all candidates withdraw. Polls signal a tight race with neither Netanyahu nor rival Gadi Eisenkot projected to reach 61 seats. Trump endorsed Netanyahu a day before Hegseth's visit. Netanyahu told Army Radio he is 'not seeking' an Iran attack before Oct 27; Trump says no Iran attack before US midterms. 120 Knesset seats on Oct 27 — first election since Oct 7, 2023.
sections.what_verified: Türkiye Today, newsbeep/Al Jazeera, ThePrint/Reuters, TVB/AP agree on withdrawal, reason, date, and the tight-race polling read. Trump's endorsement reported by Reuters. Netanyahu's no-pre-election-attack statement from bdnews24 quoting Army Radio interview.
sections.what_disputed: Pollster divergence: Shlomo Filber predicts a right-wing majority; other pollsters show a deadlock (C14 Instagram carousel). Gantz's 'unity government' motive questioned by Al Jazeera's Nour Odeh — 'not really expected' but consistent with his history of unity deals.
sections.why_matters: An election decided under war: the Oct 27 vote is the first Israeli ballot since Oct 7, and both Netanyahu and Trump are timing military moves around elections. Fault-line engagement question on the endorsement's effect.
sections.context: Background: Israel election Oct 27 — NEW: Benny Gantz withdraws 8 days before the vote (Blue and White below threshold); race tight Netanyahu vs Gadi Eisenkot; Trump endorses Netanyahu; Netanyahu says no Iran attack before election; Hegseth's unannounced visit adds wartime framing

totw_analysis: Our read: An election decided under war: the Oct 27 vote is the first Israeli ballot since Oct 7, and both Netanyahu and Trump are timing military moves around elections. Fault-line engagement question on the endorsement's effect. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Does Trump's endorsement plus wartime posture lock Netanyahu back into power — or do war-weary voters punish the far-right coalition that failed on Oct 7?
related_short_title: Gantz Quits 8 Days Before the Vote — And Neither Bloc Can Reach 61
